## Hi!

My name is Charlotte and I'm a social scientist. I am currently doing my PhD, investigating the relationship between media use and loneliness, social isolation and social exclusion among young people.

Here you can find information about my [PhD project](/PhD%20Project.qmd) and [about me](/about.qmd). At the moment, I am also interested in science communication. You may find something about this here soon. Everything is still a work in progress. In my free time, I enjoy baking and cooking, as well as building miniature models and playing darts 🎯.
